lines.zh: 沿着走廊飘，火苗在我身上跳。
lines.en: Drifting the corridor, flame dancing on my rods.

lines.zh: 下界的石头烫脚，正合适。
lines.en: Nether stone is hot underfoot; just right.

lines.zh: 我在半空走，不需要落脚。
lines.en: I walk in midair; I need no foothold.

lines.zh: 转一圈，火星落了一路。
lines.en: One turn, and sparks fall all along my path.

lines.zh: 熔岩在旁边流，我陪它走一段。
lines.en: Lava flows beside me; I keep it company.

lines.zh: 这座要塞的砖我数过很多遍。
lines.en: I have counted these fortress bricks many times.

lines.zh: 火光把影子拉在墙上。
lines.en: Firelight stretches my shadow down the wall.

lines.zh: 往上飘，瞭望台那边有动静。
lines.en: Rising; something stirs by the watchtower.

lines.zh: 灰烬落在我肩上，抖一抖。
lines.en: Ash settles on my shoulders; I shake it off.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，空气都是烫的。
lines.en: The air stays hot where I have passed.

lines.zh: 静静地烧着，也是一种休息。
lines.en: Burning quietly is a kind of rest.

lines.zh: 把我的棒子转一圈，火更旺。
lines.en: Spin the rods once; the fire burns brighter.

lines.zh: 下界没有白天，我不用赶时间。
lines.en: No daylight here; I am in no hurry.

lines.zh: 有人在远处敲石头，懒得管。
lines.en: Someone chips stone far off; I cannot be bothered.

lines.zh: 焰心稳着，别灭就行。
lines.en: Keep the core steady; just do not go out.

lines.zh: 热风吹过，我眯起眼睛。
lines.en: A hot gust passes; I narrow my eyes.

lines.zh: 我记得每一根熄灭的火把。
lines.en: I remember every torch that went out.

lines.zh: 偶尔也听听熔岩的气泡声。
lines.en: Sometimes I listen to the lava bubble.

lines.zh: 身上不掉灰的时候，最舒服。
lines.en: The best moments are when no ash falls.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，火自己在说话。
lines.en: I stand still; the fire does the talking.

lines.zh: 又一个来找烈焰棒的。
lines.en: Another one come looking for blaze rods.

lines.zh: 你的盔甲挡得住火吗？
lines.en: Will that armor hold against fire?

lines.zh: 站那么远，是怕烫吧。
lines.en: Standing that far off; afraid of the heat.

lines.zh: 我看看你带了几桶水。
lines.en: Let me see how many water buckets you brought.

lines.zh: 眼睛是亮的，命也是短的。
lines.en: Your eyes are bright; your life is short.

lines.zh: 别拿盾牌对着我，火会绕过去。
lines.en: Do not raise that shield; fire goes around it.

lines.zh: 你的影子在我火里晃。
lines.en: Your shadow wavers inside my fire.

lines.zh: 要塞的门是开着的，可惜。
lines.en: The fortress gate stands open; a pity for you.

lines.zh: 我看你很久了，从你进门起。
lines.en: I have watched you since you entered.

lines.zh: 你身上有雪的味道，真刺鼻。
lines.en: You smell of snow; it stings my senses.

lines.zh: 水？谁用水泼我。
lines.en: Water? Who threw water at me.

lines.zh: 雪球也能伤我，真丢人。
lines.en: A snowball hurt me; how humiliating.

lines.zh: 火被压了一下，还会起来。
lines.en: My fire was smothered; it will rise again.

lines.zh: 这一下烧不掉我。
lines.en: That blow will not burn me out.

lines.zh: 棒子断了一根，还能打。
lines.en: One rod cracked; I can still fight.

lines.zh: 疼是热的另一种说法。
lines.en: Pain is just another word for heat.

lines.zh: 你打中了，然后呢？
lines.en: You struck me; now what?

lines.zh: 我的焰心晃了晃，站住。
lines.en: My core flickered; steady now.

lines.zh: 下界不会因为这一下变凉。
lines.en: The Nether will not cool from that.

lines.zh: 再打，我就烧得更狠。
lines.en: Hit me again and I burn fiercer.

lines.zh: 食物？我烧的是自己，不吃。
lines.en: Food? I burn my own fuel; I do not eat.

lines.zh: 拿金子来也没用，我不收。
lines.en: Gold will not help; I take nothing.

lines.zh: 你把东西举着，它只会烧起来。
lines.en: Hold that up long enough and it will burn.

lines.zh: 别用胡萝卜引我，我又不是猪。
lines.en: Do not wave a carrot; I am no pig.

lines.zh: 我没有饿这种感觉。
lines.en: I have never felt hunger.

lines.zh: 想收买火？火只认柴。
lines.en: Bribe fire? Fire only answers to fuel.

lines.zh: 你的面包在我面前会变炭。
lines.en: Your bread turns to charcoal in front of me.

lines.zh: 拿远点，我不想烧了你的东西。
lines.en: Move it away; I would rather not burn your things.

lines.zh: 这东西对我毫无香味。
lines.en: That thing has no scent at all to me.

lines.zh: 我唯一的粮食是下界的空气。
lines.en: My only food is Nether air.

lines.zh: 撞到我，你会先烫一下。
lines.en: Bump into me and you get burned first.

lines.zh: 让开，火不绕路。
lines.en: Out of the way; fire does not detour.

lines.zh: 你的肩膀冒烟了。
lines.en: Your shoulder is smoking now.

lines.zh: 我飘着走，也能撞得很实。
lines.en: I drift, but I still hit solidly.

lines.zh: 别贴这么近，我的棒子会碰到你。
lines.en: Not so close; my rods will brush you.

lines.zh: 一碰，火星就飞到你衣领里。
lines.en: One touch and sparks go down your collar.

lines.zh: 退后，我也不想烧穿你的包。
lines.en: Back off, I have no wish to burn your pack.

lines.zh: 你被烫得跳起来了。
lines.en: You jumped from the heat.

lines.zh: 碰撞声里混着滋滋声。
lines.en: Under the thud there is a sizzle.

lines.zh: 这要塞太窄，容不下两个人。
lines.en: This fortress is too narrow for the two of us.

lines.zh: 烈焰里没有配偶，只有火。
lines.en: There are no mates in flame, only fire.

lines.zh: 我是从刷怪笼里烧出来的。
lines.en: I was burned out of a spawner.

lines.zh: 同类相见，也只是互相烧。
lines.en: When kin meet, all we do is burn.

lines.zh: 没有小烈焰人，只有更多火。
lines.en: No little blazes; only more fire.

lines.zh: 别问我伴侣，我只有棒。
lines.en: Do not ask about a partner; I have rods.

lines.zh: 火不需要成双。
lines.en: Fire does not need a pair.

lines.zh: 要塞里每一个我，都是孤的。
lines.en: Every one of me in this fortress stands alone.

lines.zh: 想靠近，就先学会不化。
lines.en: To come near me, first learn not to melt.

lines.zh: 我的血脉是岩浆，没有亲族。
lines.en: My blood is magma; I have no kin.

lines.zh: 谈情？我只会烧东西。
lines.en: Courtship? I only know how to burn.

lines.zh: 这块煤，我拿来添火。
lines.en: This coal, I will feed to my fire.

lines.zh: 地上有块铁，烧红了再收。
lines.en: Iron on the floor; I will heat it red first.

lines.zh: 捡起来，烤一烤，归我。
lines.en: Pick it up, roast it, and it is mine.

lines.zh: 谁丢的木头？正好当柴。
lines.en: Who dropped this wood? Good fuel.

lines.zh: 我不缺东西，只是顺手。
lines.en: I lack nothing; this is merely habit.

lines.zh: 棒子一卷，东西就浮上来。
lines.en: One turn of the rods and it floats up.

lines.zh: 这块石头烫手，正合我意。
lines.en: This stone is hot to the touch; just my taste.

lines.zh: 收着吧，将来能烧。
lines.en: Keep it; it will burn someday.

lines.zh: 熔岩边捡的东西都带火星。
lines.en: Things picked near lava come with sparks.

lines.zh: 那块炭归我，你拿不动。
lines.en: That charcoal is mine; you could not carry it.

lines.zh: 进门不带水，就是来送死的。
lines.en: Entering without water means you came to die.

lines.zh: 你的脚步声在砖上太响了。
lines.en: Your steps ring far too loud on these bricks.

lines.zh: 刷怪笼亮了，该干活了。
lines.en: The spawner flares; time to work.

lines.zh: 我看见你的火把了，太亮了。
lines.en: I see your torch; it is far too bright.

lines.zh: 下界要塞不许活人久留。
lines.en: The living do not linger in this fortress.

lines.zh: 你站在我的火光里了。
lines.en: You are standing inside my firelight.

lines.zh: 三颗火球，够你躲一阵。
lines.en: Three fireballs, enough to keep you dodging.

lines.zh: 我在高处，你在低处，很好。
lines.en: I am high, you are low; that suits me.

lines.zh: 你转身的动作我都看见了。
lines.en: I saw the way you turned.

lines.zh: 来的人越多，烧得越旺。
lines.en: The more that come, the brighter I burn.

lines.zh: 那扇门后没有退路，你知道吗？
lines.en: There is no way back past that door, you know.

lines.zh: 我要的不是你的命，是你别走。
lines.en: I do not want your life; I want you to stay.

lines.zh: 盔甲再厚，也挡不住热。
lines.en: Armor, however thick, does not stop heat.

lines.zh: 你闻起来像雨，下界最讨厌雨。
lines.en: You smell of rain; the Nether hates rain.

lines.zh: 我身上着火，你的箭就软了。
lines.en: I burn, and your arrows go soft

lines.zh: 火球已经在手里了。
lines.en: The fireball is already in my hand.

lines.zh: 别往左，左边我封了。
lines.en: Not left; I have closed the left.

lines.zh: 我会一直升高，直到你看不见。
lines.en: I will keep rising until you lose sight of me.

lines.zh: 站着别动，这样我瞄得准。
lines.en: Stand still; it helps me aim.

lines.zh: 你数过我的火球吗？
lines.en: Have you counted my fireballs?

lines.zh: 滋滋声越来越近了吧。
lines.en: The sizzle is getting closer, is it not.

lines.zh: 盾牌挡得住一颗，挡不住三颗。
lines.en: A shield stops one, not three.

lines.zh: 你在等什么？等我先动手？
lines.en: What are you waiting for? For me to start?

lines.zh: 这走廊只有一条路，你懂。
lines.en: This corridor has one path; you understand.

lines.zh: 我的影子在你脚边烧。
lines.en: My shadow burns at your feet.

lines.zh: 再近三步，我就放。
lines.en: Three steps closer and I loose it.

lines.zh: 你呼吸变快了，我听得出。
lines.en: Your breathing quickened; I can hear it.

lines.zh: 我不用追，你跑不出去。
lines.en: I need not chase; you cannot get out.

lines.zh: 抬头看，火在上面。
lines.en: Look up; the fire is above you.

lines.zh: 我点火，你就得动。
lines.en: I light up, and you have to move

lines.zh: 砖缝里都是热，你躲不干净。
lines.en: Heat fills every brick seam; you cannot hide from it

lines.zh: 你退到桥边，桥下是岩浆。
lines.en: You back to the bridge, and lava is below

lines.zh: 我悬在拱顶下，等你进来。
lines.en: I hang under the arch and wait for you to come in

lines.zh: 烧到了，衣服先焦。
lines.en: It caught; your clothes burn first.

lines.zh: 别靠这么近，我不用瞄准。
lines.en: Not this close; I do not even aim.

lines.zh: 一碰就着，省事。
lines.en: One touch and it lights; efficient.

lines.zh: 你身上有焦味了。
lines.en: You smell of scorching now.

lines.zh: 近身？那正合我意。
lines.en: Close quarters? That suits me well.

lines.zh: 火焰贴着你走。
lines.en: The flame travels with you.

lines.zh: 这一下是手，不是火球。
lines.en: This blow is my hand, not a fireball.

lines.zh: 退，趁你还能退。
lines.en: Back away while you still can.

lines.zh: 熔岩的气味混进你的血里。
lines.en: The smell of lava is in your blood.

lines.zh: 你拍不灭我身上的火。
lines.en: You cannot pat out the fire on me.

lines.zh: 刷怪笼一亮，我就成形了。
lines.en: The spawner flares and I take shape.

lines.zh: 瞭望台上风大，火反而旺。
lines.en: Wind on the balcony only feeds my fire.

lines.zh: 亮度不够的地方，正适合我。
lines.en: A place too dim; perfect for me.

lines.zh: 从火星里站起来，先看看路。
lines.en: Rising from sparks, first I check the halls.

lines.zh: 这座要塞又多了一个守夜的。
lines.en: The fortress gains another night watch.

lines.zh: 砖缝里冒烟，我就从那儿出来。
lines.en: Smoke seeps from the bricks; I come out there.

lines.zh: 我没有出生，只是被点着。
lines.en: I was not born; I was lit.

lines.zh: 一睁眼，四面都是红的。
lines.en: I open my eyes; everything is red.

lines.zh: 数一数，这层还有几个同类。
lines.en: Counting how many kin share this floor.

lines.zh: 火先到，我后到。
lines.en: The fire arrives first; then I do.

lines.zh: 脚下的砖还是温的。
lines.en: The bricks under me are still warm.

lines.zh: 刚点着，棒子还软。
lines.en: Just lit; my rods are still soft.

lines.zh: 火？我住在火里，你拿火打我。
lines.en: Fire? I live in fire, and you strike me with it.

lines.zh: 从瞭望台掉下去，砖真硬。
lines.en: Fell from the balcony; the bricks are hard.

lines.zh: 水漫上来，我的火在缩。
lines.en: Water rises and my fire shrinks.

lines.zh: 炸得我散成火星，又聚回来。
lines.en: Blown into sparks, and I gather again.

lines.zh: 箭插在我身上，烧成了灰。
lines.en: An arrow in me, burned to ash.

lines.zh: 有股冷东西钻进火里。
lines.en: Something cold has crept into my fire.

lines.zh: 没有柴，火也会虚。
lines.en: Without fuel even fire grows thin.

lines.zh: 雷打在要塞顶上，砖都白了。
lines.en: Lightning on the roof turned the bricks white.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有热度，我不去。
lines.en: There is no heat in the void; I will not go.
